baseline.qualification: All eight unchanged main assertions reported NRU6261; later closure-attribute adjuncts and owned resource guards are not retroactive additions to this baseline.

preservedInitialNativeAttempt.qualification: An independently authored local closure named c shadowed base c() in the raw mutation graph. Rename only that local binding to deletedFunction. No frozen acceptance assertion, native expected graph, foundation group or production input was changed.

limitations: All thirteen required semantic domains remain unfinished.
Retained parsing, source-position generation, parse-data, malformed function construction, cell tags, general coercions and complete language equality/printing remain unfinished.
Version 1 public language snapshots contain source text and do not round-trip function source-cell metadata. Worker assertions exercise R-side behavior, not metadata transport equivalence.
